questions.q: What did the captain beg Jim to bring him at the start of the chapter?
questions.evidence: you'll bring me one noggin of rum, now, won't you, matey?

questions.q: Whom did the captain say he had seen in the corner of the room?
questions.evidence: I seen old Flint in the corner there

questions.q: How did Jim respond when the captain offered him a golden guinea for rum?
choices: He refused the money but brought one glass
He took the money and brought a whole bottle
He refused to bring any rum at all
He ran to tell the doctor
questions.evidence: I want none of your money

choices: His enemies would give him the black spot before then

He would miss Jim's father's funeral

questions.q: According to the captain, what were his enemies really after?
questions.evidence: it's my old sea-chest they're after

questions.q: What position did the captain say he had held under Flint?
questions.evidence: I was first mate, I was, old Flint's first mate

choices: An order or warning to appear or face something

questions.q: What sad event happened the same evening the captain told Jim his secrets?

questions.q: What did the stranger who came along the road wear over his eyes and nose?

questions.evidence: Here's a friend for you, Bill.

choices: Skipped quickly out into the road and tapped away

choices: He was struck dead by apoplexy (a stroke)
